estimates.name: Revenue Recognition
estimates.t: Tuition revenue is recognized ratably over the instruction period.

estimates.name: Long-Lived Assets
estimates.t: Fair value estimates are based on assumptions concerning the amount and timing of estimated future cash flows.

estimates.name: Income taxes
estimates.t: GAAP requires management to evaluate tax positions taken by us and recognize a tax liability if we have taken an uncertain position that more likely than not would not be sustained upon examination by the Internal Revenue Service.

estimates.name: Share Based Compensation
estimates.t: The Company estimates the fair value of stock-based compensation awards on the date of grant using an option-pricing model.

estimates.name: Goodwill and Other Indefinite-lived Assets
estimates.t: We test goodwill and other indefinite-lived assets for impairment at least annually, or more frequently if events or changes in circumstances indicate that the asset may be impaired.
